issues.legal_issue: Multiple plaintiffs may join claims arising from connected contractual arrangements when the later arrangement follows the discharge of the earlier arrangement.
material_facts: One plaintiff sought declarations and an injunction concerning a written construction agreement to which she was a party.
The other plaintiff sought recovery of money allegedly spent under a later oral arrangement with the same defendant.
The pleaded oral arrangement followed an accord and discharge of the earlier agreement, and a transcript of conversations evidenced the transition between the arrangements.
The claims were brought together in one suit.
issues.conclusion: The suit was not bad for misjoinder of parties or causes of action, and the plaintiffs could pursue their respective claims together.
issues.legal_principle: Order I Rules 1 and 2 and Order II Rules 3 and 6 of the Code of Civil Procedure permit joinder in the circumstances specified by those rules and allow separate trials where joinder may cause embarrassment, delay, or inconvenience. A cause of action comprises the material facts supporting a right to relief. Under Ramesh Hirachand Kundanmal v. Municipal Corporation of Greater Bombay (1992) 2 SCC 524, a party is necessary where the question cannot be effectually and completely settled unless that party is joined.

predicates.civil_suit_joins_multiple_claimants: Multiple claimants brought their claims together in one civil suit.
predicates.claims_arise_from_connected_contractual_: The claimants' separate claims arose from contractual arrangements connected to the same underlying transaction.
predicates.later_arrangement_follows_discharge_of_e: The parties discharged their responsibilities under an earlier arrangement before proceeding under a later arrangement.

issues.definition: When multiple claimants bring claims arising from connected arrangements and the later arrangement follows discharge of the earlier one, their joinder is not improper.

issues.legal_issue: A court must refer a dispute to arbitration when the required agreement, scope, and timely-request conditions are met.
material_facts: A written agreement between the parties contained an arbitration clause covering disputes arising from or relating to the agreement.
A party to the agreement brought a civil suit against the other party concerning disputes within the arbitration clause's scope.
The defendant applied for referral to arbitration before submitting its first statement on the substance of the dispute.
The arbitration proceedings had already been commenced.
issues.conclusion: The court was required to refer the dispute to arbitration and could not proceed to entertain the suit on its merits.
issues.legal_principle: Section 8 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, requires referral where an arbitration agreement exists, a party to it brings an action against another party, the action's subject matter falls within the agreement, and referral is sought before the applicant's first substantive statement. The requirement is peremptory under P. Anand Gajapathi Raju v. P.V.G. Raju (2000) 4 SCC 539 and Sundaram Finance Ltd. v. T. Thankam (2015) 14 SCC 444; arbitration may commence or continue while the referral issue is pending.

predicates.civil_action_concerns_a_dispute_between_: A party to an arbitration agreement brought a civil action against another party to that agreement.
predicates.dispute_falls_within_agreement_scope: The dispute in the civil action falls within the matters covered by the parties' arbitration agreement.
predicates.referral_is_sought_before_first_substant: The party seeking arbitration applied for referral before submitting its first substantive response to the dispute.

issues.definition: When a civil action between parties to an arbitration agreement concerns a covered dispute and referral is sought before the first substantive response, the court must refer the dispute to arbitration.

issues.legal_issue: A broad arbitration commitment in a written agreement continues to govern disputes under a substituted oral arrangement that follows the parties' accord and discharge, and the connected disputes may be resolved in one arbitration.
material_facts: The written agreement contained a broad arbitration clause.
The parties' responsibilities under the written arrangement were discharged by accord, and a subsequent oral arrangement between the other claimant and the defendant replaced it.
The suit raised claims connected to both arrangements, and the Court found the original arbitration clause applicable to the oral arrangement.
issues.conclusion: The arbitration clause applied to the substituted oral arrangement, and the disputes were to be referred to the sole arbitrator already appointed for resolution in a single arbitration.
issues.legal_principle: A broadly worded arbitration clause does not become inoperative merely because the underlying agreement is terminated by mutual consent. Section 8 and P. Anand Gajapathi Raju v. P.V.G. Raju (2000) 4 SCC 539 support referral where its conditions are met. P.R. Shah, Shares and Stock Brokers Pvt. Ltd. v. B.H.H. Securities Pvt. Ltd. (2012) 1 SCC 594 supports a single arbitration where connected claims are subject to arbitration and separate proceedings risk multiplicity or conflicting decisions.

predicates.dispute_arises_from_a_substituted_agreem: A dispute arose under an arrangement that replaced an earlier agreement between the relevant parties.
predicates.original_agreement_contains_a_broad_arbi: The earlier agreement contains a broad commitment to arbitrate disputes relating to the parties' rights and obligations.
predicates.substitution_follows_accord_and_discharg: The parties reached an accord and discharged their responsibilities under the earlier arrangement before entering the substitute arrangement.
predicates.connected_claims_are_referred_together: Connected claims arising from the arrangements are referred together for arbitration.

issues.definition: When a dispute arises from a substitute arrangement following discharge of an earlier arrangement with a broad arbitration commitment, and connected claims are referred together, they are resolved in one arbitration.
